newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Benefun opens 22 pct up from IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Benefun opens 22 pct up from IPO price.

text.p: Shares in Benefun International debuted on the Stock Exchange of Singapore on Tuesday at a high of Hong Kong $1.44 after opening at HK$1.40, a 22 percent premium on its HK$1.15 initial public offer (IPO) price.
The shares hit HK$1.44 in the first 10 minutes of trade.
The clothing retail company offered 100 million new shares in its IPO, which was 105 times subscribed and has a dual listing in Hong Kong. Both listings began trading on Tuesday.
At 0115 GMT Benefun's Singapore shares had eased back to HK$1.37 on volume of 1.1 million units traded.
